stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id","parent","edge_parent","kind","line","text","ordinal","parent_start","parent_end","parent_kind","ancestor_start","ancestor_end","ancestor_kind","name_id","name_source","left_id","left_start","left_end","left_kind","right_id","right_start","right_end","right_kind","right_source","value_id","value_kind","type_id","type_start","type_end","type_kind","type_source","function_id","function_start","function_end","function_kind","object_id","object_start","object_end","object_kind","object_source","attribute_id","attribute_source","body_id","body_start","body_end","body_kind","parameters_id","parameters_start","parameters_end","parameters_kind","name" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition')

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id","parent","edge_parent","kind","line","text","ordinal","parent_start","parent_end","parent_kind","ancestor_start","ancestor_end","ancestor_kind","name_id","name_source","left_id","left_start","left_end","left_kind","right_id","right_start","right_end","right_kind","right_source","value_id","value_kind","type_id","type_start","type_end","type_kind","type_source","function_id","function_start","function_end","function_kind","object_id","object_start","object_end","object_kind","object_source","attribute_id","attribute_source","body_id","body_start","body_end","body_kind","parameters_id","parameters_start","parameters_end","parameters_kind","name" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='class_definition')

stages.name: methods
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id","parent","edge_parent","kind","line","text","ordinal","parent_start","parent_end","parent_kind","ancestor_start","ancestor_end","ancestor_kind","name_id","name_source","left_id","left_start","left_end","left_kind","right_id","right_start","right_end","right_kind","right_source","value_id","value_kind","type_id","type_start","type_end","type_kind","type_source","function_id","function_start","function_end","function_kind","object_id","object_start","object_end","object_kind","object_source","attribute_id","attribute_source","body_id","body_start","body_end","body_kind","parameters_id","parameters_start","parameters_end","parameters_kind","name","cls","class_name" FROM (SELECT f.*,c.id AS cls,c.name AS class_name FROM functions f JOIN classes c ON c.__path=f.__path
 WHERE f.parent=c.body_id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes d WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.id=f.parent AND d.kind='decorated_definition' AND d.parent=c.body_id))

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "right_source",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "type_source",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind","attr",NULL AS "object","object_text" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_id AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute')

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "right_source",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "type_source",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "callee_id",NULL AS "callee_kind",NULL AS "full_callee","callee",NULL AS "receiver" FROM (SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_id LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call')

stages.name: parameters
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "id","kind",NULL AS "text","name","annotation",NULL AS "position" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,p.id,p.kind,p.text,n.text AS name,p.type_id AS annotation,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY p.__start)-1 AS position FROM functions f JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.parent=f.parameters_id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.id=CASE WHEN p.kind='identifier' THEN p.id ELSE (SELECT child.id FROM nodes child WHERE child.__path=p.__path AND child.parent=p.id AND child.ordinal=0 AND child.kind='identifier' LIMIT 1) END
 WHERE p.kind IN ('identifier','typed_parameter','default_parameter','typed_default_parameter'))

stages.name: depths
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","id","depth" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE depths(__path,id,depth) AS (
        SELECT __path,id,0 FROM nodes WHERE parent IS NULL
        UNION ALL SELECT n.__path,n.id,d.depth+CASE WHEN n.kind IN ('block','decorated_definition','else_clause','finally_clause','expression_statement') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
        FROM depths d JOIN edges e ON e.__path=d.__path AND e.src=d.id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=e.__path AND n.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM depths)

stages.name: selected_classes
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "right_source",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "type_source",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind","name",NULL AS "chosen" FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.name ORDER BY d.depth DESC,c.__start DESC) chosen FROM classes c JOIN depths d ON d.__path=c.__path AND d.id=c.id) WHERE chosen=1)

stages.name: base_heads
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","cls","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE heads(__path,cls,id) AS (
        SELECT c.__path,c.id,b.id FROM selected_classes c JOIN nodes a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.parent=c.id AND a.kind='argument_list' JOIN nodes b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.parent=a.id
        UNION ALL SELECT h.__path,h.cls,n.id FROM heads h JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=h.__path AND x.id=h.id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=x.__path AND (x.kind='parenthesized_expression' AND n.parent=x.id OR x.kind='call' AND n.id=x.function_id))
        SELECT h.__path,h.cls,CASE WHEN n.kind='identifier' THEN n.text WHEN n.kind='attribute' THEN n.attribute_source END AS name FROM heads h JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=h.__path AND n.id=h.id WHERE n.kind IN ('identifier','attribute'))

stages.name: semantic_classes
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE semantic(__path,name) AS (
        SELECT __path,name FROM selected_classes WHERE name GLOB '*PlanStep'
        UNION SELECT c.__path,c.name FROM selected_classes c JOIN base_heads b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.cls=c.id WHERE b.name IN ('ServerPlanStep','NonPublishingStep','SqlProducingStep','SqlRelationPublisherStep','SqlScalarPublisherStep')
        UNION SELECT c.__path,c.name FROM selected_classes c JOIN base_heads b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.cls=c.id JOIN semantic s ON s.__path=b.__path AND s.name=b.name) SELECT * FROM semantic)

stages.name: step_methods
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "right_source",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "type_source",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "name",NULL AS "cls",NULL AS "class_name" FROM (SELECT m.* FROM methods m JOIN semantic_classes s ON s.__path=m.__path AND s.name=m.class_name)

stages.name: parameter_types
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","name","annotation" FROM (SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name,coalesce(n.text,'') annotation FROM parameters p LEFT JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.id=p.annotation WHERE p.kind IN ('typed_parameter','typed_default_parameter'))

stages.name: self_stores
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","id","__start","__end","annotation","value_kind","value","attr","method" FROM (SELECT n.__path,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,n.type_source annotation,n.right_kind value_kind,n.right_source value,a.attr,fn.id method FROM nodes n JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.id=n.left_id
        JOIN step_methods fn ON fn.__path=n.__path AND fn.__start<n.__start AND fn.__end>=n.__end WHERE n.kind='assignment' AND a.object_text='self')

stages.name: store_contracts
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","__start","__end",NULL AS "annotation",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "value","attr",NULL AS "method","types" FROM (SELECT s.*,coalesce(s.annotation,'')||' '||CASE WHEN s.value_kind='identifier' THEN coalesce((SELECT annotation FROM parameter_types p WHERE p.__path=s.__path AND p.fn=s.method AND p.name=s.value),'') WHEN s.value_kind='call' THEN coalesce((SELECT callee FROM calls c WHERE c.__path=s.__path AND c.id=s.value_kind||':'||(SELECT right_start FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=s.__path AND n.id=s.id)||':'||(SELECT right_end FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=s.__path AND n.id=s.id)),'') ELSE '' END AS types FROM self_stores s)

stages.name: last_methods
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "right_source",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "type_source",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind","name","cls","class_name",NULL AS "chosen" FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT m.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,cls,name ORDER BY __start DESC) chosen FROM methods m) WHERE chosen=1)

stages.name: method_calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","cls","name","callee" FROM (SELECT m.__path,m.cls,m.name,c.callee FROM last_methods m JOIN calls c ON c.__path=m.__path AND m.__start<c.__start AND m.__end>=c.__end)

stages.name: entry_reach
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","cls","entry","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE reachable(__path,cls,entry,name) AS (
        SELECT __path,cls,name,name FROM last_methods WHERE instr(class_name,'ReadThroughWriteTransaction')>0 AND name IN ('__enter__','__aenter__')
        UNION SELECT r.__path,r.cls,r.entry,m.name FROM reachable r JOIN method_calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.cls=r.cls AND c.name=r.name JOIN last_methods m ON m.__path=c.__path AND m.cls=c.cls AND m.name=c.callee WHERE m.name NOT IN ('_establish_legacy_write_authority','_establish_native_write_authority')) SELECT * FROM reachable)

stages.name: function_decorators
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","name" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id,coalesce(c.callee,a.attr,n.text) name FROM functions f JOIN nodes w ON w.__path=f.__path AND w.id=f.parent AND w.kind='decorated_definition' JOIN nodes d ON d.__path=w.__path AND d.parent=w.id AND d.kind='decorator' JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.parent=d.id LEFT JOIN calls c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.id=n.id LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.id=n.id)

relational.query: SELECT n.__path path,n.__start start_byte,n.__end end_byte,'APP001' issue,n.id identity,'Semantic plan steps must not retain transport objects' message FROM store_contracts n WHERE attr IN ('_client','client','_connection','connection','_callback','callback','_registry','registry') OR rx_matches(types,'(?:^|[\s\[\]|,])[^\s\[\]|,]*(?:Client|Connection|Transaction|Callback|Registry|Transport)(?:$|[\s\[\]|,])') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path path,n.__start start_byte,n.__end end_byte,'APP002' issue,n.id identity,'Semantic plan steps must not retain mutable runtime results' message FROM store_contracts n WHERE instr(attr,'batched_value')>0 OR instr(attr,'response')>0 OR instr(attr,'runtime_result')>0 OR rx_matches(types,'(?:^|[\s\[\]|,])[^\s\[\]|,]*(?:Response|RuntimeResult)(?:$|[\s\[\]|,])') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path path,n.__start start_byte,n.__end end_byte,'APP003' issue,n.id identity,'Transaction entry must not authenticate or bind authority eagerly' message FROM last_methods n WHERE name IN ('__enter__','__aenter__') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM entry_reach r JOIN method_calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.cls=r.cls AND c.name=r.name WHERE r.__path=n.__path AND r.cls=n.cls AND r.entry=n.name AND (instr(c.callee,'bind_cache_to_current_authority')>0 OR instr(c.callee,'adopt_authenticated_remote_session')>0 OR instr(c.callee,'resolve')>0 AND (instr(c.callee,'auth')>0 OR instr(c.callee,'authority')>0 OR instr(c.callee,'credential')>0 OR instr(c.callee,'admission')>0))) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path path,n.__start start_byte,n.__end end_byte,'APP004' issue,n.id identity,'Authentication compatibility methods must delegate to a pure lazy method' message FROM functions n WHERE (name GLOB '*_sync' OR name GLOB '*_async') AND (instr(lower(name),'auth')>0 OR instr(lower(name),'authority')>0 OR instr(lower(name),'credential')>0 OR instr(lower(name),'admission')>0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM function_decorators d WHERE d.__path=n.__path AND d.id=n.id AND (d.name IN ('legacy_sync','legacy_async') OR d.name IN ('direct_legacy_sync','direct_legacy_async') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls c WHERE c.__path=n.__path AND c.__start>n.__start AND c.__end<=n.__end AND c.callee GLOB '*_lazy')))
